mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_task ( task_no, task_type, category, name, status, connection_id, connection_name, schema_name, target_label, params, progress_percent, parent_task_id, user_id, username, create_time, last_heartbeat_time ) VALUES ( #{taskNo}, #{taskType}, #{category}, #{name}, #{status}, #{connectionId}, #{connectionName}, #{schemaName}, #{targetLabel}, #{params}, #{progressPercent}, #{parentTaskId}, #{userId}, #{username}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_task SET progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, current_stage = #{currentStage}, last_heartbeat_time = #{lastHeartbeatTime} WHERE id = #{id}
